reviewer_notes: Article Twenty One D. on PDF page 31 (printed footer "30") defines immediate family as "spouse, parents, children, brothers, sisters, mother-in-law or father-in-law, or a blood relative or ward residing in the same house" and adds one day "to attend the funeral of a relative not listed in the preceding sentence"; no other passage in the document covers bereavement-eligible relatives. Both candidates list the covered relatives correctly and quote verbatim. A cites the correct PDF page 31; B cites 30, which is the printed footer of that same page, an off-by-one PDF page error, so B fails on page and overall.
